description:
We are MIVA COSMIX, curious minds and creative problem-solvers representing MIVA Open University at NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Passionate about technology, science, space exploration and meaningful innovation.

We welcome collaborators with skills in web development, Python, AI/ML, UI/UX, data science, GIS, game development, research and storytelling.

Bring your ideas, skills and curiosity. Let's build something extraordinary together!

Different Minds. One Universe of Possibilities.
